findings.title: Limitation of Liability
findings.rationale: The evidence explicitly states the limitation on the Vendor's liability under the agreement.
evidence_excerpts: Vendor’s liability shall not exceed total contract value.

findings.title: Indemnification Obligations
findings.rationale: The evidence specifies the indemnification obligations of the Vendor towards the Client.
evidence_excerpts: 7.1 Vendor shall indemnify Client for damages arising from Vendor’s gross negligence.

findings.title: Termination for Cause Conditions
findings.rationale: The contract specifies that either party may terminate the agreement on material breach with 60 days’ notice, indicating the conditions under which termination for cause can occur.
evidence_excerpts: Either party may terminate on material breach with 60 days’ notice.

findings.title: Termination for Convenience Notice Period
findings.rationale: The evidence specifies the notice period required for termination for convenience.
evidence_excerpts: Termination for convenience requires 90 days’ notice with proportional payments for delivered goods.

findings.title: Confidentiality Obligations Survival Duration
findings.rationale: The evidence explicitly states the duration for which confidentiality obligations survive after the agreement ends.
evidence_excerpts: Confidentiality obligations shall survive termination of this agreement for 3 years.

findings.title: Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
findings.rationale: The evidence specifies the governing law and the method for resolving disputes, indicating that arbitration will be used if amicable resolution fails.
evidence_excerpts: 9.2 Failing that, disputes shall be referred to arbitration under [Country] Arbitration Act.
